chunks: And your Lord declared He would send men against them who would inflict dreadful suffering on them till the Day of Doom, for your Lord is swift in retribution, though He is certainly forgiving and kind.
ai.seo_question: Who did Allah send to inflict punishment upon the disbelievers according to Surah Al-A'raf?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as a declaration of divine justice where Allah sends a specific group—sometimes identified as the enemies of the Ahl al-Bayt or a continuous lineage of punishers—to inflict severe retribution until the Day of Resurrection. It underscores the dual nature of Allah’s attributes, balancing His swift execution of justice (Sarīʿ al-Ḥisāb) with His boundless mercy (Ghafūr Raḥīm), reminding believers that punishment is not arbitrary but a measured response to persistent transgression.
